A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area 
 is required.

Wear safety and healthy equipments as safety healthy, 
 safety shoes, ...etc.

Isolate the 
 circuit breaker of the pump motor.

Disconnect 
 electric terminals of the pump motor.

The pump must 
 be isolated mechanically by closing delivery and suction valves.

Be sure pump must 
 be completely drainage.

Manual Puller, Feeler Gauge, Rags, Cleaning 
 Fluid,

Measure 
 vibrations level for bearings and compare it with the setting value, then 
 analyze it and determine what to do (if it is needed).

Check discharge quantity and pressure and 
 compare them with the setting value then replace the worn- out components 
 (if it is needed).

Check bolts fixation, then re-tightens it 
 (if it is needed).

Check the validity of oil and add or change 
 it (if it is needed).

Check glands for leaking and re-packing (if 
 it is needed).

Check the pump casing against rust and 
 re-paint (if it is needed).

Introduction
This document outlines the 
equipment inspection list I1, which must be carried out on an annually bases as 
indicated by Y1 in the above title block.
The first draft initiated 
by eng. Sameh Foad Faried, tested by eng. Abdel Rahman Nassar at 06 April 2005, 
accepted by eng. Mohamed Abdel Salam Mahmoud general directir, revised by EDEPC 
inspection & quality control eng. Abouda Elbana, approved by eng. Tarek Yousef 
Aly: head sector of Ayon Mousa PS.
This document accepted by eng.
 Samir Abdel Gilel: EDEPC 
 inspection and 
 quality control general director & MPIS coordinator, and 
 certified by accountant: Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman EDEPC admin. & financial 
 inspection, quality control general director and supervisor of inspection & 
 quality control's head sector.
Pump Technical Specification:
Pump Name | Service Water Pumps
Pump Type | Vertical tubular casing pump 
 with mixed flow Impeller
Delivery Quantity: | 3247m3/h
Head | 37m
Speed | 495 rpm
Weight of motor | 4.8 ton
Weight of pump | 5.1 ton
Type of Recommended Oil | ISO-VG 68
Quantity of oil Filling | 17 L
Exchange interval oil | 4000 hr
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area 
 is required.
Wear safety and healthy equipments as safety healthy, 
 safety shoes, ...etc.
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area 
 is required.
Wear safety and healthy equipments as safety healthy, 
 safety shoes, ...etc.
Isolate the 
 circuit breaker of the pump motor.
Disconnect 
 electric terminals of the pump motor.
The pump must 
 be isolated mechanically by closing delivery and suction valves.
Be sure pump must 
 be completely drainage.
Tools and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set.
Main Crane, Alfa Laval,
Manual Puller, Feeler Gauge, Rags, Cleaning 
 Fluid,
Dial Indicator, Vibrometer.
Work to be Carried Out
Pump in Service
Measure 
 vibrations level for bearings and compare it with the setting value, then 
 analyze it and determine what to do (if it is needed).
Check discharge quantity and pressure and 
 compare them with the setting value then replace the worn- out components 
 (if it is needed).
Check bolts fixation, then re-tightens it 
 (if it is needed).
Check the validity of oil and add or change 
 it (if it is needed).
Check glands for leaking and re-packing (if 
 it is needed).
Check flanges for leakage.
Check the pump casing against rust and 
 re-paint (if it is needed).
